text:
He should be found guilty of **murder under the "depraved heart" (abandoned and malignant heart) theory** if the pedestrian had died. Since she was only seriously injured, the matching charge is **aggravated battery / assault with extreme indifference to human life**, under the same theory. Driving at high speed on a busy street while admitting indifference to the consequences shows a conscious disregard of a very high risk, which is more than ordinary recklessness. It also satisfies malice without any intent to injure.

CONFIDENCE: 55
